name: Memphis
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Memphis for 2026, and here is what he found: 30 family events, 10 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Memphis Zoo Lantern Festival and Graceland Christmas Tours) through December 23 (Graceland Christmas Tours and A Christmas Carol at Theatre Memphis), with Home Alone in Concert at the Orpheum (November 28), Magic of Memphis (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at the Memphis Zoo (December 12) and the Christmas Fiesta at the Dixon (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Memphis

  • 30 Christmas events for kids in Memphis
  • 10 free events, including the Christmas Fiesta at Dixon Gallery and Gardens
  • Meet Santa: Breakfast with Santa at the Memphis Zoo (December 12, 13 and 19 to 23)
  • Lights and rides: Memphis Zoo Lantern Festival with the Farm Train and CHINA carousel, and Christmas tours at Graceland
  • Shows: Home Alone in Concert, Magic of Memphis and A Christmas Carol at Theatre Memphis
  • Season: November 26 to December 23
